Instanz im Container, Compose-Setup, Age: Instance in a container, Compose setup, agent images, project containers and resource limits
`scripts/instance.sh up --name NAME` bau: `scripts/instance.sh up --name NAME` builds backend and frontend into one image with `deploy/Dockerfile` and starts exactly one container (`deploy/compose.yml`); the backend serves the frontend itself.
Einstellungen je Instanz: `deploy/instan: Settings per instance: `deploy/instances/NAME.env` — `MYSURICATES_PORT` is required, `MYSURICATES_BIND` is `127.0.0.1` unless set otherwise
Mounts für Projekte, KI-Anbieter und Doc: Mounts for projects, AI providers and the Docker socket are written by `scripts/lib/host-mounts.sh` into an override next to the Compose file
Daten liegen in benannten Volumes und bl: Data lives in named volumes and survives `scripts/instance.sh down`
`MYSURICATES_RUNTIME=host` startet diese: `MYSURICATES_RUNTIME=host` starts the same instance directly on the machine instead of in a container
`ai-automation-backend/docker-compose.ym: `ai-automation-backend/docker-compose.yml` builds and starts the backend; it only builds the agent images (profile `build-only`). The backend itself starts containers from these images through the Docker API.
Pfade relativ zu `ai-automation-backend/: Paths relative to `ai-automation-backend/`. Project containers use `automation-agent-node` (`CODE`, `PERSONAL`) or `automation-agent-python` (`RESEARCH`, `CONTENT`, `BUSINESS`) depending on the project type; shell blocks can use any allowed image via `container_image` (`automation.execution.allowed-container-images`).
Vor dem ersten Block sucht ein Run den l: Before the first block, a run looks up the running project container or starts one — provided Docker is set up and the run does not run isolated in its own workspace clone. If the start fails, the run continues without a container. The blocks themselves run on the host (exception: shell steps with `container_image`); the project container is used by ad-hoc commands during a run and by the terminal.

docker create + start (Image je Projektt: docker create + start (image per project type, bind mount, limits)
containerId (bei Fehler: weiter ohne Con: containerId (on failure: continue without a container)
execute blocks (Host), letzte Aktivität: execute blocks (host), container's last activity per step

Dazu `/tmp` als tmpfs, alle Capabilities: Plus `/tmp` as tmpfs, all capabilities dropped, `no-new-privileges` and the host's user ID
